0022600168.text: The Utah Jazz (1-5, 14th in the West) are on a four-game losing streak and take the road against the San Antonio Spurs (3-2, 8th in the West), who have won three straight at home and on the road. The Jazz trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 117-111 in Salt Lake City on October 28, and they lost 1-2 to the Spurs in 2025-26. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain).
